meta.name: phi-cleaner
meta.description: De-identify clinical text for drafts, notes, and manuscript excerpts using phi-cleaner before sharing with external tools or collaborators. Use when: (1) Removing patient names/dates/identifiers from free-text notes, (2) Producing sanitized excerpts for LLM prompts, (3) Running a PHI detection pass to audit sensitive text, (4) Preparing de-identified appendices or examples for manuscripts and presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 移除临床文本中的患者身份信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在分享临床笔记或稿件前去除患者标识符
copy.tagline_en: Remove patient identifiers from clinical text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to strip patient names and identifiers from clinical notes before sharing

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调用 phi-cleaner 工具，自动从临床文本中移除患者姓名、日期等身份信息，生成脱敏后的文本。
howto.when: 当你要求处理可能包含敏感信息的临床笔记、手稿或 LLM 提示词时触发。

say.text: 帮我脱敏这段临床记录：患者张三，2024年3月15日就诊。
用检测模式扫描这段文本中的敏感信息。
脱敏这个文件 note.txt，输出到 note.cleaned.txt。
say.note: Claude 会使用 -f 和 -o 参数处理文件。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will invoke the phi-cleaner tool to automatically remove patient names, dates, and other identifiers from clinical text, producing de-identified output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process clinical notes, manuscripts, or LLM prompts that may contain sensitive information.

say_en.text: De-identify this clinical note: Patient John Smith, seen on 03/15/2024.
say_en.note: Claude will call phi-cleaner to remove name and date.

say_en.text: Run detect mode on this text to find PHI.
say_en.note: Claude will run --detect mode to flag sensitive items.

say_en.text: Clean the file note.txt and output to note.cleaned.txt.
say_en.note: Claude will use -f and -o flags to process the file.
